_comment: 60 patient descriptions written by Team Neuraxis (20 English, 20 Hindi, 20 Hinglish) with the triage level(s) and top condition we consider clinically reasonable. Written before running the engine. NOT clinician-validated. 'levels' lists every acceptable triage level; a case with only HIGH is a true emergency, so anything lower is UNDER-triage.
